verified: Approved-ID listing and bounded Unicode pagination

Manifest classification requires trusted Supervisor content review

This broker does not disable CLI built-ins or sandbox arbitrary code
Fresh audit path prevents silent reset but is not interruption recovery
No live Controller capability, unattended continuation, research-process improvement or prediction gain demonstrated
